histoire.p1: Built in the early 20<sup>th</sup> century, the Sainte-Lucie boarding school welcomed young ladies from high society.
histoire.p2: Then, without warning, one day in 1953, the corridors emptied. The doors closed. And Sainte-Lucie was abandoned, taking with it the secrets of those who had lived there.
histoire.p3: Since then, time has stood still within its walls.
histoire.p4:
And you are the ones who have been chosen:
tonight, you will enter Sainte-Lucie.
And perhaps even understand why no one has ever come out.
histoire.question: Will you uncover the truth?

meta.title: Our story — Memoria, immersive horror experience in Lyon
meta.description: Three enthusiasts, years of work and a forgotten boarding school: go behind the scenes of Memoria and discover the dark history of Sainte-Lucie.

hero.intro: Two stories meet here. The story of three enthusiasts who gave everything to bring Memoria to life. And the story of Sainte-Lucie boarding school, which no one should ever have reopened.

coulisses.intro: Memoria was born from a frustration shared by three friends, die-hard fans of escape games and horror experiences: being scared, yes… but never for long enough, never deeply enough. So they decided to create the experience they had always dreamt of living.
coulisses.bio1: He wrote the very first pages of the story and imagined Sainte-Lucie, its boarders and its secrets. He also directs the actors.
coulisses.bio2: A carpenter by trade, he spent two years turning an empty space into a 1953 boarding school, room by room, object by object.
coulisses.bio3: Sound, lighting, mechanisms, safety: she orchestrates everything you don’t see… and everything that will make you jump.

genese.titre: From an idea to the first doors
genese.texte1: It all started around a table, after yet another escape game. One question kept coming back: what if you could live a real horror film, from the inside, face to face with real actors? The idea never left them.
genese.texte2: For months, the story was written, rewritten and tested. A girls’ boarding school, an unexplained closure in 1953, clues hidden in every room: every detail serves the story, every puzzle serves the fear.
genese.texte3: It had to be the right place. After dozens of visits, they found 200 m² over three levels in Lyon: big enough to get lost in, intimate enough to feel watched.
genese.texte4: Hand-aged walls, furniture hunted down across the region, period wallpaper, authentic objects from the 1950s: the build took almost two years so that every corner tells a story.
genese.texte5: Spatial sound, controlled lighting, hidden mechanisms and real-time effects: the technology becomes invisible so you can only think about one thing… getting out.
genese.visuel5: The sound and light control room
genese.texte6: At the heart of Memoria are people. Actors trained in improvisation and controlled fear guide you, watch you and adjust the intensity to every group.

valeurs.texte1: No screens, no cardboard sets: you are not spectators, you are inside the story.
valeurs.texte2: Three intensity levels, a safe word and a team watching over you at every moment.
valeurs.texte3: Sets, props, mechanisms: almost everything was designed and built by us.
valeurs.texte4: Our actors adapt to your group: no two games are ever the same.

atelier.intro: Sketches, building work, rehearsals: a few images from the birth of Memoria.

notreHistoire.bandeau: What if it were all true?

pensionnat.intro: What we know about Sainte-Lucie comes down to a few archives, yellowed photographs and a great deal of silence. Here is what we have been able to piece together.
pensionnat.texte1: The widow of a wealthy Lyon silk merchant, Éléonore de Saint-Aubin has the boarding school built in memory of her daughter Lucie, taken by a fever at the age of twelve. She wants to give the young ladies of high society “the finest education there is… and the protection of God”.
pensionnat.texte2: Up at six, prayers, lessons in French, piano and embroidery, silence in the refectory, curfew at nine. Some forty boarders, aged eight to seventeen, live to the rhythm of the great hall’s bell, under the eye of the headmistress, Mademoiselle Vernier.
pensionnat.texte3: Among them is Héloïse Marchand, fourteen, who arrives in the autumn of 1948. Gifted at drawing and solitary, she fills her notebooks with the same motif: a door that no one at the school remembers ever seeing.
pensionnat.texte4: As every spring, a photographer comes to take the class portrait. When the film is developed, one figure too many appears in the back row. None of the girls recognises her. As for the photographer, he never sets foot in Sainte-Lucie again.
pensionnat.texte5: The incidents multiply: a lullaby hummed in the closed wing, curtains rippling without a breath of air, the great hall clock stopping every night at 3:17. Several families take their daughters away. Mademoiselle Vernier forbids anyone to speak of it.
pensionnat.legende5: The curtains of the older girls’ dormitory
pensionnat.texte6: One November morning, the delivery man finds the gates locked. Inside, the breakfast tables are laid, the beds made, the coats hanging. There is no one left. The investigation leads nowhere and the school is sealed off.
pensionnat.legende6: The last known photograph of a boarder
pensionnat.texte7: People say the piano still plays on certain nights, that the clock has started again, that a young girl waits at a window in the east wing. Those who tried to get in all speak of a door that appears on no plan…
pensionnat.appelTexte: Tonight, Sainte-Lucie is waiting for you. Will you uncover the truth?

hero.titre: Give your team an experience they will never forget
hero.intro: Far more than an escape game, Memoria plunges your employees into an immersive adventure where communication, trust and cooperation become essential.

presentation.titre: A team building like no other
presentation.p1: Memoria offers companies an immersive, intense team-building experience that is profoundly different from traditional activities.
presentation.p2: For 90 minutes, your employees are plunged into the heart of an abandoned 200 m² boarding school. Faced with a disturbing story and the presence of professional actors, they will have to communicate, listen to each other and act together to move forward.
presentation.p3: Every team member plays a part in how the adventure unfolds. Participants must share information, manage their emotions and make decisions together, in a completely unfamiliar setting.
presentation.p4: This experience naturally brings out everyone’s strengths, while giving the team a spectacular, unifying and memorable moment.

benefices.texte1: Participants share an intense experience in which success depends on their ability to move forward together.
benefices.texte2: The adventure forces participants to pass on information clearly, listen to others and coordinate their actions.
benefices.texte3: Every participant has to be able to rely on the rest of the team to make progress.
benefices.texte4: The experience naturally reveals different qualities: leadership, listening, analysis, initiative, adaptability, stress management and team spirit.
benefices.texte5: The intensity of the experience creates a shared memory far more striking than a standard corporate activity.

difference.titre: Choose an activity that stands out
difference.intro: Where most team-building activities look alike, Memoria offers a genuine immersive theatre experience, with your employees as the lead characters.
difference.texte1: A staging in which the story moves forward with your team’s choices.
difference.texte2: A 1953 boarding school recreated down to the last detail, from the dormitory to the great hall.
difference.texte3: They interact with your teams, guide them… or put them to the test.
difference.texte4: Far from the chain of puzzles of a classic escape game, the adventure is lived, felt and shared.
difference.texte5: Low, standard or extreme: the intensity adapts to your group.

intensite.intro: So that everyone can enjoy the experience with peace of mind, you choose the intensity level best suited to your group.
intensite.texte1: A disturbing atmosphere and a gripping story, with measured interaction from the actors. Ideal for teams new to horror.
intensite.texte2: The balance between tension, surprises and cooperation, just as we designed it. Recommended for most teams.
intensite.texte3: Relentless immersion, more present actors and more testing situations. For thrill-seekers only.
intensite.garantieTexte: Whatever level you choose, no participant will ever be put against their will in a situation they refuse. Anyone can ask for a break or leave the experience at any time, and our team keeps a watchful eye from start to finish.
intensite.conseilTexte: We recommend a level based on:
intensite.conseilFin: The Memoria team advises you before booking so you can choose the right level.
